display_name: Bao Minh fire and special perils insurance rules (Quy tắc bảo hiểm hỏa hoạn và các rủi ro đặc biệt): the whole document, insuring clause, risks A to J, general exclusions, deductible, conditions, claims conditions and special endorsements

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated by tools/vnsrc.py from line N of ../../source/raw/baominh-fire.txt, and in short runs that tools/vnsrc.py check verifies occur verbatim in it. The capitalised defined term TỔN HẠI is rendered DAMAGE.

documents.authority: the insurer's own standard wording; undated (footer '_03.06'); private contract terms, not law

scope: The whole document. Encoded: the insuring clause and proviso; the definitions of TỔN HẠI, Cháy and Khủng bố; risks A to J with every limb, exclusion and deductible paragraph; general exclusions III.1-4; Section IV and its warranty; Section V; general conditions VI.2-6 with the short-period table; claims conditions VII.1-9; special endorsements VIII.1, VIII.2 Parts 1-2 and VIII.3; the closing note. Inert: the title and blank contract number, VI.1, VIII.2 Part 3, the running footer. Out of scope: none. Named refusals: the number of days in 'ngay lập tức' (VII.1(a)), and a short-period premium above the premium for the period (VI.4). What the Policy Summary or property list fixes is an input with no default. See NOTES.md sections 1-2.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in the tests was written by the same session that wrote the rules, from the text, before the assertion was run.

self_check.vnsrc: vnsrc check: 489 src: lines, 494 Vietnamese runs, 0 problems

forks.F13: Proviso (ii) is applied per item and in total.
forks.F14: VIII.1(a)(i) does not reach physical damage to tangible property.
forks.F15: VIII.2 write-back perils mapped to facts; freezing, hail, whirlwind and falling objects not matched.
forks.F16: VII.3 local-regulation measure is the cost of a lawful repair to the former condition.

forks.F24: Short-period boundary months go to the lower row.
forks.F25: VI.5 read literally: warranties bar claims only in a renewal period.
forks.F26: VI.3 changes on a claim concern the property claimed.
